consequence.statement: Waypoint pods can now have their topologySpreadConstraints configured via Helm values, allowing operators to customize pod topology spread behavior for waypoint deployments.

assertion.statement: The waypoint pod topologySpreadConstraints is now configurable via the new Helm value `.Values.global.waypoint.topologySpreadConstraints`.
